purpose: cache reuse audit and a source-attributed paper protocol; no training launcher in this delivery

reference.precedence: explicit paper definitions override conflicting repository settings; unpublished details remain unresolved

paper_training.projection: arithmetic mean over anatomical depth Z
paper_training.adversarial_formula: logarithmic minimax in equations (1),(4),(13); repository defaults to least squares, not equivalent
paper_training.vpg_l1_representation: raw segmentation logits per equations (10),(11); repository uses softmax probabilities

hcg_pretrain.settings_reference: paper's cited pix2pix protocol; not all settings restated

paper_metrics.bscan_aggregation: 2D metrics per Y-index B-scan; mean within patient, then equal-patient mean
paper_metrics.weight_application: multiply both images by 1 on annotated GT vessels and gamma elsewhere before evaluating the standard metric
paper_metrics.weighted_metric_mask: expert ground-truth vessel annotations including capillaries, not predicted or large-vessel-only masks
paper_metrics.density_binarization: each image thresholded at its own global mean; pixels above threshold are vessels
paper_metrics.vde: absolute difference of per-image vessel fractions; equal-patient mean
paper_metrics.vdc: Pearson correlation of corresponding non-overlapping 16x16 patch density arrays within each patient, then equal-patient mean

code_only_settings_not_claimed_paper_exp.declared_schedule: 100 fixed plus 100 linear decay; actual source steps scheduler only after epoch 100 and needs resolution
code_only_settings_not_claimed_paper_exp.source: official README, options, train3d.py and base_dataset3d.py

cache_source.format: float32 [1,Z,Y,X], normally [1,256,304,304], original paired measurements divided by 255, no model inference
cache_source.reuse_status: historically evidenced and structurally reusable through adapter; current server files not reverified because SSH authentication failed

unresolved_before_claiming_strict_reprod: live cache integrity and source NPZ parity
native-depth interpolation parity to author preprocessing
exact metric intensity mapping, data_range and SSIM implementation
availability of expert capillary annotations for weighted metrics
complete-view deterministic validation/test coverage and restoration
learning-rate schedule ambiguity and logarithmic GAN implementation
original-size FP32 target-GPU forward/backward memory acceptance
